quote: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.

activation.condition: A driver intends to turn right or left, or otherwise depart a direct course. The selected C412593 branch is a right turn by a freight-loading zone.

obligation.description: Give the intended turn signal continuously over the applicable final traveled distance, regardless of weather. Business or residential districts use 100 feet; other areas use 300 feet.

timing.description: During the last applicable distance before changing course.
